result.topic_en: Euler tabulates, for each prime of the form 4n+1 below 100, its representation as a sum of two squares and the general form of the numbers a for which aa+1 is divisible by that prime.
result.transcription:
112 DE NVMERIS PRIMIS
quadrata numerorum imparium, si vnitas addatur, fore
per 2 diuisibilia.
Scholion 2.
Secundum hanc ergo regulam omnes numeros
primos formae $4n+1$ tractaui, et postquam singulos
in summam duorum quadratorum conuerti, quod sem-
per et quidem vnico modo fieri potest, cuique formam
generalem ipsius $a$, in qua radices omnium quadratorum,
quae vnitate aucta per quemque numerum primum sint
diuisibilia, adscripsi, vnde sequens nata est tabula:
Tabula omnium numerorum $a$
quorum quadrata vnitate aucta $aa+1$ sunt per quem-
libet numerum primum formae $4n+1$ diuisibilia.
Numeri primi | Valor ipsius $a$
$2 = 1^2 + 2^2$ | $a = 2m \pm 1$
$5 = 1^2 + 2^2$ | $a = 5m \pm 2$
$13 = 2^2 + 3^2$ | $a = 13m \pm 5$
$17 = 1^2 + 4^2$ | $a = 17m \pm 4$
$29 = 2^2 + 5^2$ | $a = 29m \pm 12$
$37 = 1^2 + 6^2$ | $a = 37m \pm 6$
$41 = 4^2 + 5^2$ | $a = 41m \pm 9$
$53 = 2^2 + 7^2$ | $a = 53m \pm 23$
$61 = 5^2 + 6^2$ | $a = 61m \pm 11$
$73 = 3^2 + 8^2$ | $a = 73m \pm 27$
$89 = 5^2 + 8^2$ | $a = 89m \pm 34$
$97 = 4^2 + 9^2$ | $a = 97m \pm 22$
Numeri

items.quote:
quadrata numerorum imparium, si vnitas addatur, fore
per 2 diuisibilia.
items.english: ...that the squares of odd numbers, if one is added, will be divisible by 2.

items.quote:
postquam singulos
in summam duorum quadratorum conuerti, quod sem-
per et quidem vnico modo fieri potest
items.english: after I converted each one into a sum of two squares, which can always be done, and indeed in only one way
